1.consolidated_definition: Desplazarse con movimientos bruscos y desequilibrados, característicos de una persona que está ebria o de un vehículo que se mueve violentamente.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To move with abrupt and unsteady movements, characteristic of a person who is intoxicated or a vehicle that moves violently.

reference_definitions: . Dar tumbos o balancearse violentamente personas o cosas (borrachos, carruajes).
